1.w: A Psalm. A Song for the Sabbath day. [It is] good to give thanks to YHWH, and to sing praise to Your name, O Most High,

2.w: to declare in the morning Your loving devotion, and Your faithfulness in the nights,

3.w: on ten strings and on the harp, with a melody of the lyre.

4.w: For You have made me glad, O YHWH, by Your work; at the works of Your hands I shout [for joy].

5.w: How great are Your works, O YHWH, [how] very deep Your thoughts!

6.w: A stupid man does not know, and a fool cannot understand this:

7.w: The wicked sprout like grass, and all the workers of iniquity blossom, to be destroyed forever and ever!

8.w: And You [are] on high forever, O YHWH!

9.w: For behold, Your enemies, O YHWH—for behold, Your enemies will perish; all the workers of iniquity will be scattered!

10.w: But You have lifted high my horn like that of a wild ox; I have been anointed with fresh oil.

11.w: And my eye has looked on my enemies; of those rising up against me, those doing evil, my ears hear.

12.w: The righteous one will sprout like a palm tree; like a cedar in Lebanon he will grow.

13.w: Those planted in the house of YHWH, in the courts of our God, they will sprout.

14.w: Still bearing fruit in old age, they will remain fat and flourishing—

15.w: to declare that YHWH my Rock [is] upright, and [there is] no injustice in Him.
